verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a first-party Webhook API that lets integrators subscribe to specific platform events, with updates pushed rather than polled. It also describes real-time internal transfers and real-time Fedwire settlement, which supports the event-driven, real-time half of the story. Nothing shows ledger balance reads that reflect holds or pending activity, or that webhooks cover every transaction state change; the Plaid/Finicity balance checks apply to external accounts, not Synctera's own ledger. missing for 10: documented available-vs-posted balance reads that reflect holds and pending activity, evidence that webhooks fire for every transaction state transition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
